reason: E2 shows Mn has frustrated magnetic moments in the quinary alloy and suggests frustration can be engineered by changing Mn, but it does not link this to a lowered fcc-to-hcp barrier or to mechanical properties. E1 notes nanotwins in CrCoNi and the quinary alloy but does not attribute differences to magnetism or Mn removal. The key mechanistic links between magnetism, phase transformation, and work hardening are not supported by the cited evidence.
